notes: Two cards stacked, 12 mm apart: FRONT at y 0-88 (name art warped for the seat), BACK at y 100-188 (live text, drawn as seen from the back; print on the reverse, flip about the vertical axis). 300 g lemon board #feed95, black print. Crease x=82 (valley from the printed face). Artwork = melted uppercase name, plain text warped first then melted in sheet space (blur 0.10 x local cap, thr 0.32, letter-spacing +0.06 cap). Bezier paths, fill only.

Strip (y 6-40) + tent card (y 58-158) on one proof sheet; separate boards in production (strip 200 g, tent 300 g lemon #feed95). layer-art = interleaved slices of the melted name (A facets) and DINNER + 10.10.2026 (B facets) as filled paths, plus crease ticks as thin filled rects. Tent text is live (rotate 180 about the back-panel centre). Crease positions listed in walkby_geometry.json; valley = score printed face, mountain = score back.
